description: Get an overview of the stored memory: total count, the number of learned concept associations, the list of domains, and average quality scores. This memory is shared across all AI tools the user has connected to Mnemoverse. Use it to orient yourself, to confirm the exact domain name before writing to it, or when the user asks what you remember. Read-only — changes nothing.
name: memory_stats

avg_importance.description: Average importance of stored memories, on a scale from 0 to 1.

avg_valence.description: Average valence of stored memories: how well recalls turned out, on a scale from -1 to 1.

episodes.description: Number of individual memories (not merged into a summary).

hebbian_edges.description: Number of learned concept-to-concept associations; memory_graph reads them.

prototypes.description: Number of summary memories merged from several individual ones. Consolidation is not running on the hosted service, so this count does not currently grow.
